Its own canonical valid fixture therefore represented LOCAL_OBSERVE_ONLY with local_activation_access=false while still carrying J-Space observation refs and MEASURED_SUPPORTED epistemic status.
observed.risk: A receipt could structurally claim measured local J-Space observation without the local activation access required to observe the hookable residual-stream substrate. That weakens the evidence boundary between measured latent telemetry and compiled/external compatibility modes.
observed.parallel_overlap_check: No open PR matching LOCAL_OBSERVE_ONLY activation-access fencing was found. Open UCF PRs #1132/#1133 address boot Claude enablement and boot generation ancestry instead.

grf.R0_OBSERVED: LOCAL_OBSERVE_ONLY plus local_activation_access=false was admitted by source and used by the canonical valid fixture.
grf.R1_INFERRED: Observation-only should mean latent observation without steering, not absence of activation access. Without activation access, a local measured J-Space claim is unsupported.
R2_ALTERNATIVES: leave LOCAL_OBSERVE_ONLY permissive and rely on provenance text
fail closed on both local J-Space modes without activation access
grf.R3_COUNTER_REALITY: A local runtime might expose derived telemetry without direct tensor handles. Under the current owner architecture that still does not justify the existing local latent-mode claim unless the admitted capability surface is explicitly represented; silently using local_activation_access=false is ambiguous.
grf.R4_DISCRIMINATOR: Require activation access for both FULL_LOCAL_LATENT and LOCAL_OBSERVE_ONLY while leaving COMPILED_EXTERNAL/PLAIN_COMPATIBILITY activation-free.
grf.R5_EMERGENT: J-Space mode now encodes an observability boundary rather than merely a label plus lens digest.
